requirement: Allow clients in 10.0.1.0/24 to access the management network 10.0.99.0/24.

proposal.rationale: The requirement to allow clients in 10.0.1.0/24 to access the management network 10.0.99.0/24 can be satisfied by configuring an access policy on r1 (the client-facing router) that permits traffic from 10.0.1.0/24 to 10.0.99.0/24. Since r1 is connected to the client network and the transit link to r2, and r2 is responsible for reaching the management network, the traffic must pass through r1 to r2 via the transit link. The access policy on r1 ensures that client traffic is allowed to reach the management network through the router infrastructure. No additional static routes are needed because the transit link and routing rules already ensure that traffic flows correctly between networks via the defined next hops.
